name: field
description: 表单字段容器：Label/HelperText/ErrorText/输入控件经 Ark UI Field 上下文自动接线 id、aria-invalid 与 aria-describedby/aria-errormessage。

files.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { PropType } from "vue";
import { Field as ArkField } from "@ark-ui/vue/field";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const props = defineProps({
  /** 校验失败态；不传时由使用方自行判断（default: undefined 禁用 Boolean casting） */
  invalid: { type: Boolean as PropType<boolean | undefined>, default: undefined },
  disabled: { type: Boolean, default: false },
  required: { type: Boolean, default: false },
  class: { type: String, default: undefined },
});
</script>

<template>
  <ArkField.Root
    :invalid="props.invalid"
    :disabled="props.disabled"
    :required="props.required"
    :class="cn('flex flex-col gap-1.5', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkField.Root>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Field as ArkField } from "@ark-ui/vue/field";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

// v-if 语义：Ark 仅在 invalid=true 时渲染，否则不产生 DOM 元素
const props = defineProps<{ class?: string }>();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkField.ErrorText :class="cn('text-destructive text-sm', props.class)">
    <slot />
  </ArkField.ErrorText>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Field as ArkField } from "@ark-ui/vue/field";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const props = defineProps<{ class?: string }>();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkField.HelperText :class="cn('text-muted-foreground text-sm', props.class)">
    <slot />
  </ArkField.HelperText>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Field as ArkField } from "@ark-ui/vue/field";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const props = defineProps<{ class?: string }>();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkField.Input
    :class="
      cn(
        'flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 aria-invalid:border-destructive',
        props.class,
      )
    "
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Field as ArkField } from "@ark-ui/vue/field";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const props = defineProps<{ class?: string }>();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkField.Label
    :class="cn('text-sm font-medium leading-none data-invalid:text-destructive', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </ArkField.Label>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Field as ArkField } from "@ark-ui/vue/field";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const props = defineProps<{ class?: string }>();
</script>

<template>
  <ArkField.Textarea
    :class="
      cn(
        'flex field-sizing-content min-h-16 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-base shadow-sm transition-[color,box-shadow] outline-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:ring-[3px] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50 aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 aria-invalid:border-destructive md:text-sm',
        props.class,
      )
    "
  />
</template>
